title: Using Machine Learning Imputed Outcomes to Assess Drug-Dependent Risk of Self-Harm in Patients with Bipolar Disorder: A Comparative Effectiveness Study.
summary: The study used a retrospective claims cohort of approximately 1.3 million patients, cross-validated imputation, and compared drug-dependent self-harm risk. Conclusions depend on the imputation model and claims-derived outcomes; the study does not directly observe all self-harm events.
ai_technology: Machine-learning imputation estimated uncoded self-harm outcomes in a large bipolar-disorder claims cohort and supported comparative drug-risk analyses.
organization: Center for Global Health, University of New Mexico Health Sciences Center; University of New Mexico Department of Computer Science
